eyebrow: POS GMO · Built for N Companies
title2: Software that adapts to each one.
intro: POS GMO is a multi-company business platform serving Company 1 through Company N. Each company can have its own products, services, workflows, operational rules and business needs. A laundry, grocery store, water business, retailer or manufacturer is a company using POS GMO, not a separate GMO application.
tabsLabel: Example companies / verticals on POS GMO

rule.title: Tenant isolation
rule.text: companyId comes from the authenticated session context. It never comes from an AI agent or LLM output.

factory.title: What this means for Factory
factory.notThis: Factory does not build “Inventory for Laundry.”
factory.butThis: It builds a generic POS capability that can adapt to Company A, B, C and N.
